name: InterContinental Dubai Marina
positioning: An art-filled InterContinental in the heart of Dubai Marina, a short stroll from the Walk and the beach at Jumeirah Beach Residence, with rooms, Club InterContinental and residences up to three-bedroom apartments
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable Dubai Marina base near Jumeirah Beach and the Dubai Tram
Families or groups who want residence-style apartments, with a children's pool and kids eating free

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Dubai Marina, within walking distance of Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina Mall and the Dubai Tram.
The hotel puts art at the core of its design.
Rooms have high-tech amenities, stylish furnishings and modern artwork.
Accommodations include Club InterContinental and residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom hotel apartments.
The hotel has a spa and a Pilates studio.
The Beauty Spot Spa offers hydrotherapy.
The outdoor pool at Urban Lounge is heated.
The pool area includes a children's pool.
Kids eat free at the hotel.
Ginter is an intimate gin bar with white walls, retro furniture and marina views.
The hotel is single-use plastic free.

highlights.text: With design furniture and bespoke art pieces throughout, the lobby doubles as an open-space gallery with statement statues and figurines.
The Walk and the beach at Jumeirah Beach Residence are a short stroll from the hotel.
At Urban Lounge, guests can sip a drink in a private cabana on the terrace as the pool sparkles against the cityscape.
The penthouse is designed with warm lighting and a soft color palette with hints of green.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban marina setting may not suit travelers seeking a quiet beachfront or secluded resort.
